selection_contract.universe: all non-gate records in the target-qualified runtime scenario registry
selection_contract.selected: runtime.affected records selected by the declared scenarios, groups, or tags
selection_contract.omitted: every unselected proposition is named as scenario/<target>/<name> with reason unaffected-by-declared-semantic-impact
selection_contract.full_escalation: an unmapped runtime impact selects the full universe and records no scoped unaffected omission
selection_contract.tamper_response: a plan whose runtime.affected rows differ from the deterministic selector is rejected

checks: selected plus omitted proposition coverage equals the target scenario universe

non_claims: This receipt is not a qualified gameplay candidate or release approval.
Candidate-specific selected and omitted values are materialized in the exact verification plan, not prefilled in this source receipt.
An unaffected omission never authorizes cross-target runtime evidence reuse.
